purpose: Post hoc fixed literature-derived predictor-set comparison, standalone author review
reference: Eke PI, Dye BA. J Periodontol. 2009;80:1371-1379. doi:10.1902/jop.2009.080607. Figure1, p1373
reference_set: All eight predetermined CDC/AAP self-report questions, not a reduced stepwise-selected subset or original published coefficients
endpoint: CDC/AAP moderate or severe, raw audited scalar classification
function_definitions: Unchanged functions extracted from archived formal_common.py; attribution-only imports omitted
threshold: Highest finite cutoff reaching >=90% weighted sensitivity on new pooled outer OOF predictions, frozen before target use
inference: 2000 paired full-design Rao-Wu PSU resamples, original target seed, fixed predictions and cutoffs, pointwise intervals
